[[File:Ardougne Teleport icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Ardougne Teleport''' teleports the caster to [[East Ardougne]] [[Ardougne Market|market]]. This spell can only be cast after reading the [[Ardougne teleport scroll]], which is a quest completion reward from the [[Plague City]] quest. Once the player reads the scroll they will memorise the spell Ardougne Teleport and the scroll will crumble to dust. If a player loses this scroll, they can go back to [[Edmond]] in north-west of East Ardougne to get a new one. Casting the spell is a requirement for the [[Medium Ardougne Diary]].
